@rule2 cols foot
@sig 39
@obs body: the rules of the frame are printed heavy outside and thin inside; set as in the other tables. The rule between the years and the months is printed heavy.
@obs figure: the thin rules between the subheads of the Syrian and the Persian years are printed broken; «كبائس» is printed with the hamza of its yāʾ broken.
@obs body L15: a dot is printed before the 13 of the Syrian years; not transcribed.
@obs body L23: a dot is printed after the 21 of the Persian years; not transcribed.
